profile.headline: Open to New Opportunities
profile.summary:
- Senior full stack software engineer with proven experience in storage, cloud and internet space.
- Experience developing Web-based UIs as well as Java GUI management applications.
- Java, Python, Golang, C/C++, Javascript, React, REST, AJAX, Dojo Toolkit, JQuery, SQL/Postgres, Linux, Apache, Node.js/NPM, Lighttpd.
- 15 years plus experience in storage industry developing management UI applications.  Familiar with iSCSI SAN storage concepts and terminology.
- Experienced in Agile and Test Driven Development methodologies.  Designed and developed software from requirements using stories / tasks with 2 week sprints.  Unit testing with JUnit and Python.  Agile tracking utilizing JIRA.  
- Virtual machines, VMWare, vSphere, Java Plugin development, Docker containers.
- Software version control using SVN and Git. 
- Proficient in creating UI graphic mock-ups using GIMP and Photoshop.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Data Portal for Pivot3 Customers to provide data analytics of monitored systems.  Implemented web UI using Javascript, React, NPMjs web server.  Portal accessed a REST API backend using Python and PostgreSQL in Docker containers.
- Redesigned an internal Technical Support Portal that provided customer reports and managed alert notifications.  Implemented Support Portal using Javascript, React, Golang, Python and NPM web server.  Improved loading time from 2 minutes to a few seconds.
- Wrote Python scripts to query the Monitoring daemon and generate alerts on system components.
- Designed UI mockups for Acuity UI feature, Tier to Cloud, to allow Pivot3 arrays to push volume block data to Cloud Storage Providers (AWS/Google).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- NexGen Storage spun off as independent business.
- Designed enhancement features for Web UI to manage the NexGen N5 storage systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- SAN Disk acquires Fusion IO / NexGen
- Designed and implemented Web UI functionality to manage the NexGen N5 storage systems. Developed web UI using Javascript, Dojo toolkit, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Fusion IO acquires NexGen Storage.
- Developed vSphere Web Client Plugin to manage multiple NexGen N5 storage system.  Implemented a Model-View-Controller design.  The Java Servlet service data layer accessed the REST API to create datastores mapped to N5 volumes.  Plugin UI manages N5 systems and related objects: VM datastores, hosts and virtual machines.
- Designed and implemented enhancements for the NexGen N5 management application. Developed web UI using Javascript, Dojo toolkit, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented Web-based UI (WBI) features for the NexGen N5 management application.  WBI utilized Javascript, Dojo toolkit, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS on Lighttpd web server.  The WBI accessed the REST API to communicate with the FUSE backend on the N5 storage system.
- Features developed include Performance Dashboard, Volume Provisioning, iSCSI host management, User Sessions and Event Log View

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and tested the Centralized Management Console (CMC), a Java Swing GUI application for managing LeftHand Networks clustered storage systems.  The CMC implemented a Model-View-Controller architecture.  The User Interface utilized a Tree View and multi-window tabbed panel.  
- The main CMC view was designed to list all discovered storage systems, either in a pool of Available Nodes, or grouped into Management Groups and clusters.  CMC allowed a user to assign one or more storage nodes as managers, which maintain quorum for distributed clustered storage.
- Functionality developed includes:
    - Getting Started wizard: discover storage nodes, configure RAID, create cluster and a volume.
    - Volume creation (thin/full provisioning) at the cluster level.
    - Performance monitoring at cluster, volume and storage node levels.  Performance Monitor included real-time graphical views and tabular view of statistics, such as IOPS, Throughput and Network Utilization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developed a Java Swing GUI application to manage digital catalogs for public and private libraries.  The GUI application provided a Tree View UI.  The GUI accessed a SQL database to load library users, books and related data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a Search engine with Image Recognition technology using Java web server technology.
- The Search form was implemented using JSP and Java Servlet based web forms for users to query the image search database.  The image query parameters searched a SQL database of processed image data to locate matching images.  The Search result page displayed a table of matching image thumbnails.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Java Server Page (JSP) web applications for various clients.
- Designed and implemented a Java application to generate a Photomosaic style image effect for a client's advertising campaign.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed object-oriented C/C++ X-windows/Motif management software for Northern Telecom's PCS Wireless product.
- Developed firmware for Northern Telecom's DMS-MTX basestation product.
